audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Ornn / Skill / Mordekaiser x5, contradicting the 2637-game packet chart (Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Ornn) and the already-audited mirror, which flipped rows 0, 1, 3 and 6 to Skill / Mordekaiser / Skill / Ornn. The page's own whys already described the corrected rows.
audit.why: whys[0] says 'you're both weak level-1s' (Skill, not Ornn); whys[1] says 'he wins any short trade at 2' (Mordekaiser, not Skill); whys[3] says 'trade back evenly' (Skill, not Mordekaiser); whys[6] says the Masterwork upgrades make you the anchor (Ornn, not Mordekaiser). Four rows rendered the opposite of their own explanation.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 6 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group -> Skill, Mordekaiser, Skill, Ornn, with ratings 5/10, 4/10, 5/10, 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was generic and never gave Realm of Death's 140s rank-1 cooldown or named Darkness Rise.
audit.why: Realm of Death at 140s rank 1 is the longest cooldown in the matchup — it defines a two-and-a-half-minute window where Ornn's pattern is free. Darkness Rise arms after 3 landed attacks or spells, so the stack count is the tell for whether an extended trade is safe.
audit.corrected: Spikes now read: Mordekaiser — Darkness Rise stacked, Realm of Death at 6 (140s), first item. Ornn — level 3 for Bellows Breath, Iceborn Gauntlet, 2-item front line.
sources: kit: Realm of Death 140/120/100, Darkness Rise text

audit.whatIsWrong: Only Realm of Death was ever named; Death's Grasp, Obliterate, Indestructible and Darkness Rise were referred to as 'his E', 'his Q', 'W heal' or 'his answer'. No ranges or cooldowns anywhere.
audit.why: Death's Grasp (E) 'pulls all enemies in an area' at 700 range on 16/14/12/10/8s — it is the ability that starts every Mordekaiser trade, and it is what drags Ornn off his own pillar. Obliterate (Q) at 675 range, 8/7/6/5/4s, deals increased damage 'when hitting a single enemy', so standing away from the wave is what makes his slam hurt. Indestructible (W), 12/11/10/9/8s, 'stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield' he can consume to heal — meaning damage you land is converted into his sustain, which is exactly why Grievous Wounds timing decides the extended trade. Realm of Death (R) is 650 range, 140/120/100s.
audit.corrected: All five abilities named with their real ranges and cooldowns; the pull-into-isolated-Obliterate sequence stated explicitly; Indestructible restated as damage-fed sustain that anti-heal answers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried placeholder text ('His 1v1 realm') and tracked no cooldown but the ult.
audit.why: Death's Grasp is the punishable one: 16s at rank 1, and while it is down Mordekaiser has no way to pull Ornn off his pillar.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now lists Realm of Death (650, 140s) and Death's Grasp (16s at rank 1) as the two windows to count.

audit.why: report[8] already prescribes anti-heal early against his healing, which matches the missing-interaction flag; the dos block now reinforces it with the actual mechanism.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2].d and dosFull[1].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad, so three of the six lane rules said the same thing.
audit.why: Repeated text costs the player three of the few lines they read on a loading screen.
audit.corrected: Each rule now carries a distinct mechanic: the pull, the anti-heal, and the shield-feeding problem inside the realm.
